races.name: Bear's Big Birthday EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Bated Benevolence
runners_data.comment: Half-sister to the yard's ordinary 7f Tapeta winner Galileo Charm; the market will guide
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal; Bated Breath half-sister to 7f AW winner Galileo Charm (RPR 68); dam unraced sister to useful 7f/7.7f winner One Nation; stable off the mark with 2yos (second time out); check the betting.

runners_data.name: Poppy Foxy
runners_data.spotlight: 21,000gns yearling; by Bungle Inthejungle; second foal of a 1m/1m2f winner (RPR 82), herself a half-sister to a Grade 3 winner in the US; stable yet to strike with 2yos this year (as of Friday evening) but she's bred for the job.

runners_data.name: Treasurer
runners_data.spotlight: 40,000euros yearling; twelfth foal; half-brother to seven winners including Gordon Bennett (5f/6f; RPR 102), Lorelei Rock (5f 2yo including Listed; 94) and Es Raco (Swedish Listed-placed 5f/6f including 2yo; 92); dam French 7.5f AW winner, half-sister to 1m2f Group 3 winner Regime; stable have had some 2yo success this year; market useful.

runners_data.name: Whiskey Bent
runners_data.spotlight: 50,000euros yearling, 32,500gns breeze-up 2yo; by Hello Youmzain; first foal of a French maiden from a useful family; stable off the mark with 2yos for the year; market to guide.

runners_data.name: Big Bad Storm
runners_data.spotlight: 3,000gns foal, £27,000 yearling, £15,000 breeze-up 2yo; by Ubettabelieveit; fifth foal; half-brother to 6f-8.6f 2yo winner Isobar Wind (including AW; RPR 69); dam 5.7f/6f winner (including 2yo; 78), half-sister to useful 6f/7f winner Shimmering Dawn; stable had a newcomer win at the Craven meeting; not discounted.

runners_data.name: Grayrobin
runners_data.spotlight: 43,000euros yearling, resold £36,000 yearling; by Havana Grey; first foal of a 5f AW winner, herself a sister to a 5f winner from a good sprinting family; stable's 2yos have made bright start to the year; betting to guide.

runners_data.name: Zohar
runners_data.spotlight: 25-1 when ninth of 13 at Newmarket 16 days ago (6f, good), finishing 4l behind Regal Chita; work to do to turn the tables; stable also run Treasurer.

runners_data.name: Carry On Chaos
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to a French 5.5f 2yo winner; stable runs four newcomers in this
runners_data.spotlight: 40-1 and never in the hunt on his recent Redcar debut (6f, good); may need more time.

runners_data.name: Thunda Struck
runners_data.comment: Shaped well when a debut second at Ripon; a likely player with more to come
runners_data.spotlight: Promising second at Ripon on debut (6f, good) but she failed to build on it at Leicester (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago; others stronger.

runners_data.name: Regal Chita
runners_data.comment: March foal; 21,000gns yearling; yard off the mark with its juveniles and betting can guide
runners_data.spotlight: The penny dropped late on at Newmarket on his debut 16 days ago (6f, good), passing a few in the final furlong to snatch third close home; should be more streetwise today; key player.

runners_data.name: Harley
runners_data.spotlight: Never a threat to the principals but he wasn't beaten far when fifth of six on his Hamilton debut (6f, good) 16 days ago; could leave that well behind in time.

races.name: Construction Day 14th Oct Handicap

runners_data.name: High Chieftain
runners_data.note: Prominent style perfectly suits this race shape but returns from 93-day break which raises fitness concerns
runners_data.spotlight: No immediate improvement for the switch to handicaps and a longer trip (8.6f) when fourth of five at Wolverhampton in February; still has time to do better and cheekpieces could give him a lift.

runners_data.name: Legacy Rock
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with excellent recent form but needs strong pace to be effective and faces 5lb penalty
runners_data.comment: 2-2 over 1m and he won well on Saturday; big player despite his 6lb penalty
runners_data.spotlight: 2-2 since upped to 1m, winning a pair of Class 5 events at Windsor, the latest eight days ago in comfortable fashion; 5lb higher in his hat-trick bid but he hasn't reached his ceiling just yet.

runners_data.name: Daretobedifferent
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer who should benefit from the 1m½f trip extension but remains a maiden after 11 attempts
runners_data.comment: Third for fifth time latest; steps up to 1m and can go well; vulnerable for the win though
runners_data.spotlight: 11-race maiden but she has been competitive in her last two handicaps and should remain so; could have more to offer at the trip; each-way shout once again.

runners_data.name: Spacewoman
runners_data.note: Natural pace-setter returning from 35-day break with 3lb weight drop but poor recent handicap record
runners_data.comment: Has enough to prove upped further in distance
runners_data.spotlight: Promise in novice/maiden company but she is yet to kick on in handicaps, including when only eighth over C&D on her reappearance five weeks ago; another 3lb lower today and cheekpieces are given a go; others look safer.

runners_data.name: Blue Celestial
runners_data.note: Hold-up style relies on strong pace but solid recent AW form needs proving on turf
runners_data.comment: Third in both outings here (7f); probably stays this far and each-way claims again
runners_data.spotlight: In the frame in four of her six runs since joining James Tate, keeping on well for second at Kempton (1m) 11 days ago; more to prove on turf though and others look stronger.

runners_data.name: Space Moon
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from poor form stable with trainer running at 0/23 in last 14 days
runners_data.comment: Solid sixth of 17 in 7f Leicester handicap 12 days ago so she needs considering eased 1lb
runners_data.spotlight: She has run creditably in her three handicap starts without suggesting she was ahead of her mark; others bring stronger credentials.

runners_data.name: Sweet Mabel
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 134-day absence with concerning fade-in-finish pattern noted
runners_data.comment: Unexposed filly but she needs a transformation back in trip on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form in four runs for David Loughnane, including when blowing the start on her handicap debut (1m, AW) in January; something to prove on her turf and stable debut (same owners).

races.paceDynamic: Spacewoman and Space Moon will contest the early lead, with High Chieftain sitting prominent just behind them in third. The moderate early pace should be sustainable given only two confirmed front-runners in a seven-horse field, allowing the pace to build gradually through the middle stages. Legacy Rock, Daretobedifferent, Blue Celestial and Sweet Mabel will all settle towards the rear, creating a large group of hold-up horses who will need the race to develop into a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace without getting involved in early speed battles, as they'll have first run on a large pack of closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Suits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If Spacewoman and Space Moon set a steady tempo without going too fast early
scenarios.body: High Chieftain can track the leaders perfectly positioned and has the class edge to quicken when the pace lifts approaching the final furlong. The hold-up horses will find too much traffic and not enough pace collapse to close effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Spacewoman and Space Moon engage in a speed duel through the early stages
scenarios.body: Legacy Rock and Daretobedifferent will benefit from the strong gallop as proven closers with recent winning form. The front-runners will pay for their exertions in the final furlong allowing the back-markers to sweep past.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Spacewoman settles into an uncontested lead with Space Moon tracking
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Spacewoman to dictate terms and kick clear when ready, using her prominent style to maximum advantage. The closers will be relying on others to apply pressure that doesn't materialise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners fade badly leaving no tempo in the race
scenarios.body: Sweet Mabel and Blue Celestial get the slow-run race that maximises their finishing kick despite question marks over current form. The lack of early pace turns this into a 2-furlong sprint finish that suits pure closers.

watchPoints.text: Spacewoman breaks slowly as she did in January which would leave Space Moon as lone pace-setter
Legacy Rock gets trapped behind the large group of hold-up horses in the straight causing traffic problems
High Chieftain shows any signs of rustiness early given the lengthy 93-day absence from racing
Space Moon kicks too hard early trying to establish position given trainer's poor recent strike-rate
Sweet Mabel's jumping from the stalls after blowing the start badly on handicap debut

races.name: When You Wish Upon A Star Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Dark Whisper
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid debut form who should appreciate the step up to 1m½f after 45-day break under in-form Osborne
runners_data.spotlight: Promising start to his career when second of ten, beaten 5.5l, in the Wood Ditton at Newmarket last month (1m, good; newcomers race); the winner of that race is a smart prospect but the results of those in behind have been mixed; open to plenty of improvement and he looks a strong contender.

runners_data.name: Lucky Camino
runners_data.note: Another prominent type coming off unlucky debut at course and distance just 12 days ago, shortening preparation could be ideal
runners_data.comment: 42,000gns yearling; Lucky Vega half-brother to four winners; market informative
runners_data.spotlight: Looked a bit unfortunate not to make a winning start to his career over C&D (good to soft) 12 days ago, rallying in the final furlong having been tight for room against the fair rail when launching his challenge; stable going well; solid chance.

runners_data.name: Livemore
runners_data.note: Newcomer with high OR rating and strong breeding for middle distances, unknown quantity but pedigree suggests stamina
runners_data.spotlight: 15,000gns foal, 45,000gns yearling; eighth foal; brother to 7f/1m winner Organ (RPR 92), closely related to three winners including Sound Of Cannons (1m-1m4f including 2yo/Australia; 102) and Ghadbbaan (1m4f-2m; 75); dam Listed-placed 1m1f/1m2f winner (101); has a useful standard to aim at on debut; betting to guide.

runners_data.name: Leonardo Blu
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who showed promise at Doncaster over 1m, needs strong pace to be effective from rear
runners_data.comment: 50,000gns yearling; siblings include a Listed winner; no forlorn hope on his debut
runners_data.spotlight: Well-bred 3yo who was  a promising second of six, despite looking badly in need of the experience in the closing stages, in a 1m novice Doncaster four weeks ago (good to firm); that form has been boosted since by the winner and the fourth; open to improvement.

runners_data.name: Turton
runners_data.note: Fading finisher with poor recent form, 38-day break and gelding operation suggest connections seeking improvement
runners_data.spotlight: 14-1, slowly away and never in contention in a Southwell novice last month (7f); gelded since; improvement essential to trouble the principals.

runners_data.name: Sunnie Jim
runners_data.note: Weak debut effort and lengthy odds-on form, hold-up style needs significant pace which may not materialise
runners_data.spotlight: 50-1, slowly away and always behind on his Southwell debut ten days ago (1m).

runners_data.name: Symphony's Song
runners_data.note: Four-year-old with poor AW form returning to turf, prominent style gives tactical chance in weak field
runners_data.comment: Modest form in one run for George Boughey 425 days ago; non-runner 2.58 Windsor Monday
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in two AW runs 425 days apart (the latest her stable debut); minor handicaps on the agenda soon.

races.paceDynamic: Dark Whisper and Lucky Camino will likely share early pace duties, with Symphony's Song potentially pressing from wide. The 1m½f trip on good ground should produce a steady gallop rather than fierce early fractions, allowing the pace to build gradually. With most runners carrying hold-up styles (Leonardo Blu, Turton, Sunnie Jim), there's limited early speed beyond the two prominent runners. This measured tempo strongly favours prominent runners who can dictate from the front and kick clear before the closers can mount their challenge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Dark Whisper and Lucky Camino establish comfortable positions without pressure
scenarios.body: The steady gallop allows both to conserve energy and quicken decisively in the straight while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground. Their superior ratings and race experience prove decisive against the largely inexperienced field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses close late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong between the front pair
scenarios.body: Leonardo Blu and potentially the newcomer Livemore benefit from the increased tempo, swooping late as the leaders tire. The extra half-furlong gives closers crucial time to deliver their challenge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer springs surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Livemore shows significant improvement on debut with professional handling
scenarios.body: The 120 OR suggests genuine ability and his unknown running style could catch opponents off-guard. His breeding suggests stamina for the trip while fresher legs overcome the experience deficit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If both prominent runners fail to fire leaving a pedestrian gallop
scenarios.body: Symphony's Song or one of the rank outsiders benefits from the crawling tempo and sprint finish. The lack of genuine pace-pressure allows any horse with a turn of foot to be competitive.

watchPoints.text: Dark Whisper and Lucky Camino must be monitored for how aggressively they dispute the early lead as this dictates the entire race shape
Leonardo Blu needs to be positioned closer than usual given the likely steady pace and his hold-up style preference
Livemore's market movement will reveal stable confidence given his debut status and unknown ability level
Symphony's Song could benefit significantly if both market leaders engage in early pace battle
Track the positioning of Turton and Sunnie Jim as early strugglers could signal the pace is genuine

races.name: Wildwest Beer Festival 4th July Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Ruby's Profit
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 24-day break with moderate recent form, likely to set the pace but vulnerable late
runners_data.comment: Has gained all wins in spring; finished nicely at Bath on Monday; fighting chance
runners_data.spotlight: In good form for most of 2025, winning two 5f handicaps last spring; not quite hit those heights this time around, including from a good draw at Chester 24 days ago (met some trouble in the home straight); today's drop into a Class 4 will help and she is back against her own sex; should go well.

runners_data.name: Sugar Hill Babe
runners_data.note: Front-running course winner off just 1lb higher mark, recent return to form suggests she can repeat C&D success
runners_data.spotlight: Her front-running C&D win last May came off just 1lb lower; ended 2025 quietly but she returned to form after six months off, keeping on well for second at Musselburgh (5f, good) 32 days ago; takes on some less-exposed 3yos but likely to go well.

runners_data.name: Time To Take Off
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist moving into handicaps with just three career runs, sharp 5f suits her finishing kick perfectly
runners_data.spotlight: Looked good when winning a C&D maiden on her debut last October (good to soft; form franked); beaten twice in novice company this spring but she moves into handicaps with the potential for more.

runners_data.name: Novelette
runners_data.note: Class hold-up performer returning from 275-day layoff, her juvenile form suggests significant ability if ready to go
runners_data.spotlight: Improved with each of her first four 2yo runs, following a Yarmouth novice win with a cosy success at Sandown last July; flopped on soft ground wn last seen but that isn't the run to judge her on; absent for 275 days but likely there is more in the tank.

runners_data.name: Emerald Harmony
runners_data.note: Ex-Irish prominent runner who ran a cracker on stable debut, 15-day turnaround suggests connections are confident
runners_data.comment: Has made solid start for new yard; one of the likelier candidates
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish mare; ran a cracker on her stable debut at Newcastle in March (5f), beaten a nose by a well-handicapped opponent; mixed fortunes in three runs since; others may have her measure today.

runners_data.name: Chicory
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse dropping back to 5f from 6f efforts, question marks over whether minimum trip suits her style
runners_data.spotlight: All races at 6f, winning a Newbury fillies' maiden last August before being highly tried on her next two starts; disappointing on her seasonal/handicap debut at Southwell last month; drops to 5f on a recovery mission.

runners_data.name: Wateen
runners_data.note: Class hold-up horse returning from 273-day break under new trainer Robert Cowell, layoff a major concern despite ability
runners_data.spotlight: Formerly trained by Alice Haynes; highly tried as a 2yo after winning a 5f Lingfield maiden (good ground), running her best race when third of seven in a Listed race at Deauville last August (5f, good to soft); not obviously well treated for her handicap debut but she has joined a stable known for their sprinters and looks worth a market check.

races.paceDynamic: Ruby's Profit and Sugar Hill Babe are both prominent runners who will likely contest the early lead in this small field of seven. With only these two showing genuine pace-setting tendencies, the gallop should be sustainable rather than frantic over this minimum trip. The lack of confirmed front-runners means the pace won't be destructive, allowing horses to travel kindly throughout. This moderate tempo strongly favours hold-up horses who can deliver late kicks, as the prominent runners will have done enough work to be vulnerable in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ruby's Profit and Sugar Hill Babe set a steady tempo without killing each other off
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows closers to position perfectly and unleash their finishing kicks when the pace-setters tire. Time To Take Off, Novelette, and Wateen all possess the tactical speed to capitalise on this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and Ruby's Profit or Sugar Hill Babe conserves enough energy
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters gets an easy lead and has enough left to repel late challenges over this sharp 5f trip. Sugar Hill Babe's course and distance win from similar tactics makes her the most likely beneficiary.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Positioning Key
scenarios.trigger: If Emerald Harmony can secure the perfect stalking position behind the leaders
scenarios.body: The ex-Irish mare gets first run on the pace-setters and her prominent style proves ideal for this intermediate tempo. Her Newcastle near-miss suggests she can strike from this tactical position when getting the right setup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both Ruby's Profit and Sugar Hill Babe fail to establish any meaningful gallop
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawling affair that turns into a pure sprint finish where class tells. Novelette's previous form figures and Wateen's Listed race experience become crucial in a tactical battle.

watchPoints.text: Novelette faces a massive 275-day layoff test and may need the run despite her obvious class advantage
Ruby's Profit could get an uncontested lead if Sugar Hill Babe doesn't show early pace, making her dangerous despite poor recent form
Time To Take Off represents the in-form James Tate stable and her hold-up style perfectly suits the likely pace scenario
Emerald Harmony's 15-day turnaround suggests Paul Midgley thinks she's well handicapped after her Newcastle near-miss
The lack of genuine front-runners means this race will likely develop into a sprint finish favouring horses with tactical speed

races.name: Dine In Sherwoods Restaurant Handicap

runners_data.name: Diamond Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with proven jockey but poor recent form and 30 days off suggest he needs this run
runners_data.spotlight: On a losing run and he was tried in blinkers when a below-par seventh of ten in 1m6f handicap at Goodwood 30 days ago; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Bulldog Spirit
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who scored over course and distance but struggling since switching yards this spring
runners_data.comment: Beat one for new handler at Wolverhampton last month; needs to take a big step forward
runners_data.spotlight: Scored over C&D last May for Brian Ellison; yet to fire for his new yard in handicaps at Wolverhampton (1m4f) and Lingfield (2m) this spring though.

runners_data.name: Little Peter
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner returning from 166-day break but showed life in recent point-to-point victory
runners_data.comment: Sole attempt over C&D resulted in a success off current mark in October 2024
runners_data.spotlight: A fair 2m winner at his best but he came in last in 2m Newcastle handicap in December; won a point last month though so is no forlorn hope.

runners_data.name: Tazaman
runners_data.note: Patient stayer who should improve significantly for recent pipe-opener at Doncaster after seven-month absence
runners_data.comment: Two wins last summer came at a lesser level, latterly over 2m1f; returns from a layoff
runners_data.spotlight: A dual winner (1m4f/2m1f) in 2025; off seven months before beating one in 1m4f handicap at Doncaster 29 days ago but should strip sharper here.

runners_data.name: Tupero
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in excellent form with proven stamina but faces 4lb rise after impressive Redcar victory
runners_data.spotlight: French recruit who is in excellent form for his current yard, gaining a second win of 2026 in 1m6f handicap at Redcar 24 days ago; up 4lb but had something in the tank there so he's a player.

runners_data.name: In The Post
runners_data.note: Front-running type seeking maiden win with solid recent Doncaster third and low-mileage profile appealing
runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who arrives in good form, third of seven in 1m4f handicap at Doncaster 15 days ago; not out of things in his bid for a maiden victory.

runners_data.name: Two Plus Two
runners_data.note: Front-runner with excellent recent Bath win but faces quick 3lb rise and in-form trainer struggling lately
runners_data.comment: Won twice on fast ground last May; recent reappearance was a step back in right direction
runners_data.spotlight: Back in excellent form after 12 months off and landed 1m6f handicap at Bath nine days ago; up 3lb but this gutsy front-runner is not taken lightly.

races.paceDynamic: Little Peter and In The Post will ensure a genuine early gallop in this small field, with both needing to make the running from their low draws. Two Plus Two may also get involved early given his front-running tendencies, creating a potentially strong pace over the extended trip. The honest tempo should set up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses to finish strongly in the final three furlongs. This pace shape clearly favours the patient, staying types who can produce late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine with Little Peter and In The Post pushing each other
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will stretch the field and tire the early leaders, allowing the closers to pick up the pieces in the final two furlongs. Tazaman and Tupero are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Two Plus Two gets an easy lead while the other pace-setters cancel each other out
scenarios.body: The Bath winner can dictate terms at his own pace and have enough left to repel late challenges, especially with his proven stamina at this trip. His excellent current form gives him the edge in a tactical battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Diamond Bay can sit just off the pace while the leaders go too fast early
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old can use his experience to time his challenge perfectly when the front-runners tire, benefiting from the strong gallop without being part of it. Rob Hornby's tactical nous could prove decisive in positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If all three potential leaders are restrained early creating a crawling pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where early position matters more than stamina, potentially suiting the horses with tactical speed. This scenario would turn the race on its head and favour different profiles entirely.

watchPoints.text: Little Peter's fitness after 166 days off - if he shows early pace his stamina could evaporate quickly
Two Plus Two's ability to handle the quick turnaround from Bath win just 9 days ago at this longer trip
Tazaman's improvement from his Doncaster pipe-opener - he typically needs his first run back from breaks
In The Post and Little Peter engaging in early speed duel which could set up perfect scenario for closers
Diamond Bay's headgear change to blinkers failed last time and his form trend suggests he's going backwards

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Galaxy Star
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 7lb claimer aboard but faces traffic issues in small field with strong early pace
runners_data.comment: Made a successful Flat debut in Kempton maiden; considerably more is needed however
runners_data.spotlight: Did well in bumpers; won a 1m3f AW maiden and then ran surprisingly well in a 1m4f Listed race; that did her mark no favours but Harry Vigors takes off 7lb and she might do better again.

runners_data.name: Lady Dora Mae
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with 8-day turnaround after Windsor win, perfectly placed to exploit lack of early pace
runners_data.comment: Solid second (1m1f, good) four weeks ago and highly likely to be competitive again
runners_data.spotlight: Progressing and likeably consistent; dug deep to finish the job off at Windsor (1m, good to firm) last week and gives the impression that she'll be fine over this far (stays 1m1f); respected off 5lb higher.

runners_data.name: Silken Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in retained first-time hood, 13 days since last run gives her freshness edge
runners_data.comment: 50-1 winner on her second start, at Southwell last month; third at Haydock since.
runners_data.spotlight: Progressing when winning a 1m AW maiden (in a first-time hood that's been retained) and third in a Haydock novice; her sixth of seven in a Wolverhampton handicap (8.6f) was a backward step, though.

runners_data.name: Sharp Romance
runners_data.note: Lightly raced prominent type with class edge, just missed in similar conditions at Newmarket
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced filly who won a 1m AW maiden before just missing out on her handicap debut at Newmarket (1m2f, good) where she did well given she saw plenty of daylight ahead of her; only 2lb higher.

runners_data.name: Shady Bay
runners_data.note: Course and distance winner last time but 5lb higher mark has troubled her before
runners_data.comment: Off the boil in the autumn; one result is she's now just 1lb above her last winning mark
runners_data.spotlight: Now 311 over C&D after beating four rivals with ease a month ago (good); this 5lb higher mark has proved troublesome in the past but those runs were elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Bearin Up
runners_data.note: Hold-up filly moving up from Class 5 company, longer trip should suit but needs luck in running
runners_data.spotlight: Her second win in ten starts when a cosy winner at Newmarket (1m, good); 5lb higher and that was a Class 5 event, but this longer trip might eke out further improvement.

runners_data.name: Dunkeld Dreamer
runners_data.note: In-form prominent racer with course and distance experience, solid each-way claims
runners_data.comment: Good fourth in Beverley handicap 13 days ago; in the mix off an unchanged mark
runners_data.spotlight: In form and although beaten 8l into second at Hamilton (1m1f, good) the winner looked way ahead of her mark; has finished runner-up over C&D and can run well again.

races.paceDynamic: Lady Dora Mae emerges as the sole confirmed front runner in this small field, with Silken Bay, Sharp Romance, Shady Bay and Dunkeld Dreamer all holding prominent positions behind her. With only one natural leader, Lady Dora Mae can dictate terms and set a sustainable gallop through the middle stages at this staying trip. The lack of early pace pressure means she won't be softened up, while the prominent brigade will likely track in a bunch behind her before the real racing begins in the final three furlongs. This scenario strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems, while hold-up horses Galaxy Star and Bearin Up face the challenge of making ground against a solid wall of horses in a small field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Dora Mae gets an easy lead and maintains her rhythm
scenarios.body: She faces no early pressure and can quicken off her own pace, while the prominent pack behind struggles to close the gap in time. Her recent Windsor success and proven stamina give her the tools to resist late challenges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses get first run on Lady Dora Mae
scenarios.body: Sharp Romance or Dunkeld Dreamer can use their tactical speed to challenge turning in and overwhelm the leader. The hold-up horses get caught behind the early pace battle and can't make up the ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go too early and empty out
scenarios.body: Galaxy Star or Bearin Up benefit from a strong pace collapse and sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. The small field helps them find room despite their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Dora Mae goes too slow and kicks too soon
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse can win, negating the tactical advantages. Sharp Romance's class and Dunkeld Dreamer's form give them edges in a messy finish.

races.name: £9 Racedays At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap

runners_data.name: Leadenhall
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who needs strong pace to aim at, 6lb lower than last win but faces tactical test here
runners_data.spotlight: 6lb lower than when winning at Haydock last summer (1m, good to firm); two creditable runs in defeat this season and he now drops in class.

runners_data.name: Great Blasket
runners_data.note: Course and distance winner suits these conditions, solid Windsor run suggests return to form
runners_data.comment: Failed to fire on AW over the winter but yard is going well so he could bounce back
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner; 5lb lower than for his last success; ran a solid race on this month's return to turf at Windsor; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Stardancer
runners_data.note: Long absence since June concerns, needs things to fall right from hold-up style on return
runners_data.spotlight: Promise in AW novices and again when third of ten at Doncaster on her handicap debut last June (7f, good); disappointed at Yarmouth the following month and absent since; has undergone wind surgery during his layoff; drops in class, up in trip and tongue tied for his return; still has potential.

runners_data.name: The Sweet Escape
runners_data.note: Won here last month from prominent position, ideally placed to track Prodigal Son
runners_data.comment: Narrow winner at Nottingham in April and recently went very close at Leicester; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Saw off 14 rivals when narrowly winning over C&D last month (Class 6); also went close in a Class 6 at Leicester this month but either side of that he was unplaced in Class 5 events; others preferred for the win.

runners_data.name: Prodigal Son
runners_data.note: Only natural leader with blinkers helping recent form, 5lb claimer reduces burden
runners_data.comment: In first-time blinkers when winning here over 1m; stamina to prove over this far
runners_data.spotlight: Blinkers have helped him this spring, seeing off five rivals at Bath (1m, firm) last month and then finishing close up in third back at Bath (1m2f, firm) 19 days ago; returning to a mile can help and Mason Paetel's claim is a useful one.

runners_data.name: Penelope Valentine
runners_data.note: Winter AW form may not translate to turf, 81 days off questions fitness
runners_data.spotlight: Won two AW handicaps (7f/8.6f) over the winter; the handicapper may have caught up now and she still has to prove she can be as effective on turf.

runners_data.name: Bass Player
runners_data.note: Tongue tie returns but recent form poor, needs career-best effort from hold-up
runners_data.comment: Had a major blip at Wolverhampton in January and needs to bounce back after wind surgery
runners_data.spotlight: Ended 2025 with two good runs but he has been well short of that level in two runs this year, a wind op before the latest making no difference; tongue tie returns; risky despite his reduced mark.

races.paceDynamic: Prodigal Son is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate from the start, with The Sweet Escape likely to track him in second. With minimal early pace pressure, Prodigal Son can control the tempo and make it a tactical affair rather than an end-to-end gallop. The predominantly hold-up field (Leadenhall, Great Blasket, Stardancer, Penelope Valentine, Bass Player) will be bunched behind the leaders turning for home. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours the front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Prodigal Son leads uncontested and maintains control through halfway
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate fractions and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still getting organized. The Sweet Escape benefits from tracking the pace without pressure and can challenge late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the field bunches entering the straight
scenarios.body: Superior class horses get time to wind up their challenge from off the pace. Leadenhall and Great Blasket can use their stamina to wear down tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Prodigal Son goes too slowly early and gets caught in a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the final furlong where natural speed trumps position. Bass Player and Stardancer can quicken best in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If The Sweet Escape or another forward runner challenges Prodigal Son early
scenarios.body: Both pace setters compromise each other and set it up for the closers. The hold-up horses get the perfect scenario with weakened leaders.
